english.title: Cause use of vehicle with unlit load overhanging front
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), at a time between

(A)_[sunset and sunrise]_
(B)_[sunrise and sunset when visibility was seriously reduced]_

a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), carrying

(C)_[a load]_
(D)_[equipment]_

which projected beyond the front of the vehicle by more than 1 metre without complying with the requirements for an additional front lamp and reflecting device as specified in item 5 in column 3 of the table to regulation 21 of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 21(1)(b)of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
caused the use on a road of a vehicle
between sunset and sunrise/sunrise and sunset
when visibility was seriously reduced
when the load/equipment projected
beyond front for more than 1 metre
no additional front lamp/reflecting device fitted

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The above offence wording may be adapted to other overhanging/projecting loads and equipment (see regulations 21 and the table thereto in Butterworths Road Traffic Service Part 2 at page 2944).
(ii) The maximum permitted projection in the case of an agricultural vehicle or a vehicle carrying a fire escape is two metres.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H3071 and H3073.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) when the vehicle was carrying

(A)_[a load]_
(B)_[equipment]_

which projected beyond the front of the vehicle for **(..SPECIFY DISTANCE..) and which did not carry an additional front lamp and reflecting device as required by regulation.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale (level four if goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
